summary: Native investment product definitions and details.
purpose: Inspect complete native product roots, configured rules and returned versions without history expansion.

fields.meaning: Physical native record identity; distinct from product code.

fields.name: incrementProductCode
fields.meaning: Business product code; not the Get lookup.

identity_description: Native nonblank string physical product ID.
limitations: List POST JSON /incrementProductsPage.json sends only tenant GUAPW3SG, rowStart 0 and qualified pageSize 5000; native total completeness is required. Width is not a demonstrated maximum.
List retains all native fields, nested arrays/objects, nulls, precise values, returned versions and arrival order. No latest reducer, upstream filters or extra terminal query.
Currency, bank and status are exact local repeatable filters, usable offline. Bare offline List replays its saved acquisition.
Get POST form /incrementProductDetail.json sends only tenant and physical incrementProductId; it preserves the complete native data root with exact identity echo.
Get and selected-window live --with-detail do not publish cache or Duckdog data. Separately queried product history and rate-source groups remain outside this leaf.
Returned nonblank tenant must match GUAPW3SG; missing, null and blank native tenant values remain unchanged.
